prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Finish a premium ARC Daily competitor portrait in the editor-approved GLAMOROUS CYBERPUNK character aesthetic. Hand-painted/airbrushed graphic-novel realism with sculpted inked facial planes, rich tactile metal, dramatic cinematic light; the SAME coherent illustration treatment across face, skin, hands, costume and machines. The editor explicitly wants idealized handsome heroic characters BASED ON their references, not literal actual photographic faces. Smooth flattering painted complexion, balanced attractive features, stronger sculpted jaw/cheekbones, groomed hair, expressive striking eyes. No pasted-on head, pores/blemishes copied from a snapshot, photographic skin, anime, retro pulp halftone or generic superhero stranger. Preserve only broad signature identity cues while glamour-redesigning the face. Enormous graphics cards, visible PCBs, cooling fans, heat sinks, copper/coolant pipes and geometric ARC-square displays define this world. Facial optics and headset integrate physically into temple/ear/cheek/collar machinery. This is fantasy character design, not evidence about actual methods, spending or formal team jobs.

These are NVIDIA CITADEL characters. The NVIDIA fortress must have its OWN look: vast sleek BLACK-GRAPHITE and EMERALD-GREEN GPU superstructure, monumental parallel server aisles and towering fan walls, angular cantilevered command decks, green-lit coolant conduits and distant snowy mountains. One subtle green NVIDIA-style eye pictogram may establish the faction, but NO lettering. No Tufa spiders, spider symbols, factory-yellow gantries, academy domes or copied Tufa room. Crimson accents suggest worthy elite rivals, not villains. No evil scowl, skulls, threatening minions, or franchise costume/actor likeness.

Portrait5:7, ideally1500x2100, full bleed with no frame. Head/upper-body, all essential face, hands and hero apparatus inside upper70%, face near upper third; calmer dark lower quarter for later programmatic trading-card graphics. Absolutely NO names, letters, digits, labels, ranks, medals, text, logos with lettering, scoreboards, comic titles, banners with writing, captions, watermark or card border. Only the illustration: another assistant adds all baseball-card typography/badges/stats later. ONE main character. JEAN-FRANÇOIS PUGET: THE NVIDIA MASTERMIND. Image1 is ALREADY his correct illustrated character, so use that as the identity foundation instead of hunting or pasting a raw photo. Preserve the handsome swept chestnut/dark-brown hair, neatly sculpted full brown beard, intelligent intense eyes and signature one-eye cyber optic. Elevate him into a charismatic, composed mature commander with an attractive wry almost-smile, striking sculpted illustrated cheekbones and a commanding presence. Keep human face readable, not hidden by a full mask. Do not borrow image2's clean-shaven face or its exact mastermind costume.
Pose/composition: Puget leans slightly FORWARD in a distinctly angular black-and-emerald GPU command chair, elbows poised on broad transparent control arms, one articulated gloved hand lightly near his bearded chin in a calculating gesture, other hand spreading an immense architectural HOLOGRAM OF THE NVIDIA GPU CITADEL. The hologram is a geometric architectural model with colored ARC-square channels, not text or a small cube. A concise confident tactical mastermind portrait with visual intelligence and elegance, visibly different from Jeroen's relaxed crossed-leg pose and raised hand.
Costume: bespoke GRAPHITE cyber command coat, restrained deep CRIMSON lapel lining and one crimson shoulder panel, green-lit silver/copper hardware; subtle tailored angular lines rather than navy/gold brocade. His signature silver/cyan eyepiece is redesigned with emerald-lit circular optics, elegant brow hardware, copper ear assembly and substantial jaw/collar interface. A pair of absurdly oversized horizontal graphics-card blades mounted on the CHAIR architecture make a distinctive angular halo, deep black heat sinks and luminous green cooling loops. Background: inside his gigantic NVIDIA GPU CITADEL control bridge overlooking abyss-like server aisles and emerald fan towers, crystalline angular windows onto snow mountains. A small green eye pictogram cut into a distant black wall, no text, no spider emblem. Warm crimson highlights and silver-green light make him a respected formidable rival, never an evil boss.

review: First NVIDIA mastermind composition retained as superseded draft. Editor required a clearly older sixties mentor with gray beard; use v2 for the current portrait. Editor subsequently required a fuller face/build, ponytail, spectacles and CPMP helmet engraving; current version is cpmp-ponytail-v3.
